description: This Java source file defines the PolicyNotModifiableException class, a final exception class used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It represents a specific error condition where a policy cannot be modified due to insufficient permissions. The class extends DittoRuntimeException and implements PolicyException, providing static factory methods, a builder class, and various annotations related to immutability and JSON parsing.
